projects.description: An AI-powered campus surveillance system that transforms CCTV feeds into intelligent safety monitoring.
lines: # Campus Eye
### An AI-powered campus surveillance system that transforms CCTV feeds into intelligent safety monitoring.
Campus Eye is an AI-powered campus surveillance and safety monitoring system
built using YOLO and OpenCV. It aims to enhance campus security by detecting
potential safety violations and suspicious activities, including triple
riding, ID card compliance, fighting, and other abnormal situations. The
system explores real-time video analysis, automated detection, and
intelligent surveillance to transform traditional CCTV infrastructure into a
smarter campus safety solution.
Built with Python · YOLO · OpenCV · Computer Vision · AI

projects.description: A smart healthcare platform integrating IoT patient monitoring with intelligent hospital management.
lines: # MediCrew
### A smart healthcare platform integrating IoT patient monitoring with intelligent hospital management.
MediCrew is a healthcare technology platform designed to connect patient
monitoring, hospital workflows, and intelligent digital experiences. Built
around IoT-based monitoring using ESP32 and healthcare management
interfaces, it explores patient vitals tracking, appointments, doctor and
patient dashboards, and AI-assisted health insights. The project aims to
bridge connected medical devices and digital healthcare management into a
unified platform.
Built with IoT · ESP32 · Firebase · AI · Web Development

projects.description: A solar-powered smart floating waste collector designed to tackle water pollution using IoT.
lines: # SeaBin
### A solar-powered smart floating waste collector designed to tackle water pollution using IoT.
SeaBin is a smart floating waste collection system concept focused on
addressing water pollution through embedded systems and sustainable
technology. The proposed solution integrates solar energy, ESP32, motors,
water sensors, current monitoring, and camera-based intelligence to support
waste collection and monitoring in water bodies. It explores autonomous
operation, energy-efficient design, and IoT-based environmental monitoring
to develop a practical approach to aquatic waste management.
Built with ESP32 · IoT · Solar Energy · Sensors · OpenCV · AWS

projects.description: Rethinking food delivery through a modern, intuitive, and product-focused digital experience.
lines: # Decuise
### Rethinking food delivery through a modern, intuitive, and product-focused digital experience.
Decuise is a food delivery platform concept designed to build a modern food
ordering experience beyond conventional delivery applications. It explores
intuitive restaurant discovery, food browsing, digital ordering workflows,
and consumer-focused product experiences. The project focuses on building a
scalable digital product with a strong emphasis on user experience, modern
interface design, and innovative food delivery interactions.
Built with React · Web Development · UI/UX · Product Design

Black Peak Studio is a digital venture focused on turning ideas into digital

projects.description: An offline business billing and inventory management application built for practical business workflows.
lines: # NXT-BILLS
### An offline business billing and inventory management application built for practical business workflows.
NXT-BILLS is a desktop business management application designed to simplify
billing, accounting workflows, and inventory management for small
businesses. It includes functionality for sales, purchases, invoices,
inventory tracking, ledgers, debit and credit notes, and business reports.
Designed with an offline-first approach, the application explores a
practical alternative to cloud-dependent business management tools, with an
emphasis on usability, reliability, and streamlined operations.
Built with JavaScript · Desktop Development · Database · Business Software

projects.description: An AI-powered industrial safety monitoring system for detecting PPE compliance in factory environments.
lines: # Factory Safety Detection
### An AI-powered industrial safety monitoring system for detecting PPE compliance in factory environments.
Factory Safety Detection is a computer vision-based industrial safety
monitoring system built using YOLOv8 and Python. It focuses on identifying
personal protective equipment compliance, including helmet and safety vest
usage, within industrial environments. The project explores automated safety
monitoring, visual detection, real-time alerts, and potential integration
with CCTV systems and edge computing devices to improve workplace safety
awareness.
Built with Python · YOLOv8 · OpenCV · Streamlit

projects.description: A digital event platform designed to streamline campus event discovery and engagement.
lines: # VIT Pulse / GatePulse
### A digital event platform designed to streamline campus event discovery and engagement.
GatePulse is a campus-focused event management platform concept designed to
improve how students discover, explore, and engage with college events. It
aims to create a centralized digital experience for event information,
participation, and campus activities through a modern web interface. The
project explores digital event discovery, accessible design, and streamlined
student engagement.
Built with React · Vite · Web Development

projects.description: A unified AI gateway exploring local language models and flexible AI-powered application integrations.
lines: # ORBIT API
### A unified AI gateway exploring local language models and flexible AI-powered application integrations.
ORBIT API is an AI infrastructure project exploring a unified gateway for
integrating language models into applications and developer workflows. It
focuses on simplifying AI interactions, experimenting with local models
through Ollama, and creating a flexible API layer for assistant systems and
AI-powered applications. The project aims to explore model interoperability,
local AI infrastructure, and simplified integration of AI capabilities into
software.
Built with Node.js · LLMs · API · Ollama
